players.product: Power supply and facility systems for data centers and semiconductor factories: substation equipment (switchboards, molded transformers) and UPS

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuji Electric semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-14-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April - September 2025): net sales JPY 543,160 million (up JPY 45,783 million, +9.2%), a record high, on higher plant and system sales in Energy and Industry; operating profit JPY 42,759 million (up JPY 2,423 million) and ordinary profit JPY 41,733 million (up JPY 2,784 million), both records, as higher demand for plants and systems offset higher labor costs, soaring raw material prices, lower demand for xEV power semiconductors and the reaction from the prior year's banknote-redesign demand; net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 26,614 million (down JPY 8,925 million, against a prior-year gain on the sale of investment securities). Management states capital investment in power, manufacturing and data centers stayed firm on GX investment and rising energy demand from generative AI and digital technology, machine-tool demand showed a gradual recovery and xEV demand remained on a plateau.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 543,160 million (+9.2%); operating profit JPY 42,759 million; ordinary profit JPY 41,733 million; net income JPY 26,614 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuji Electric semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-14-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Energy segment H1 FY2026: net sales JPY 165,234 million (prior-year H1: JPY 144,001 million) and operating profit JPY 18,959 million (prior-year H1: JPY 10,015 million). Facility and Power Supply Systems sales and profit rose on higher demand for data centers; Energy Management rose on more storage battery system projects and more large orders for substation equipment for power and industrial customers and power supply equipment for industrial customers; Power Plants rose on large renewable energy projects; Facilities Construction rose on large projects and cost reduction.
quarterly_data.figure: Energy net sales JPY 165,234 million (prior-year H1: JPY 144,001 million); operating profit JPY 18,959 million (prior-year H1: JPY 10,015 million)

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuji Electric semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-14-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Management states that in H1 the company worked to expand production capacity for switchboards and power panels and for transformers and switchgear to meet strong demand, and advanced its SiC power semiconductor capital investment plan in line with demand fluctuations while anticipating future market growth.

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuji Electric semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-14-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Other segments H1 FY2026: Semiconductors net sales JPY 108,725 million (prior-year H1: JPY 108,048 million) and operating profit JPY 8,973 million (JPY 15,059 million) - industrial sales rose on demand in China and currency effects, automotive sales fell on lower domestic and overseas xEV power semiconductor demand, and profit fell on that decline, higher costs for capacity expansion and raw materials; Industry net sales JPY 206,345 million (JPY 175,380 million) and operating profit JPY 11,007 million (JPY 8,137 million) on large IT Solutions projects and demand growth in Asia and Europe for FA components; Food Distribution net sales JPY 52,383 million (JPY 58,286 million) and operating profit JPY 5,806 million (JPY 8,709 million).
quarterly_data.figure: Semiconductors net sales JPY 108,725 million, operating profit JPY 8,973 million (prior-year H1: JPY 15,059 million); Industry net sales JPY 206,345 million, operating profit JPY 11,007 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuji Electric semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-14-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductors R&D in H1 FY2026: the company began sample shipments of its latest 8th-generation IGBT modules, with loss 10% or more lower than 7th-generation IGBT; mass production of the 750V/600A direct water-cooled M682 power module with 7th-generation RC-IGBT chips for mini and small car inverters started in April 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: 8th-generation IGBT loss 10% or more lower; M682 module 750V/600A
